entries.name: Sun, planet, Moon, Saturn ring, and Milky Way textures
entries.author: Solar System Scope
entries.text: Textures by Solar System Scope (https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Includes the Sun, Mercury, Venus, Earth day, night and clouds, Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn and its rings, Uranus, Neptune, and the stars and Milky Way panorama. Derived from NASA elevation and imagery data.
